(ns clbg.pidigits.optimized
  (:require [clbg.support :as s])
  (:import [java.math BigInteger])
  (:gen-class))
(def two (BigInteger/valueOf 2))
(def three-coefficient (BigInteger/valueOf 3))
(def four-coefficient (BigInteger/valueOf 4))
(def ten (BigInteger/valueOf 10))
(defn integer [value] (BigInteger/valueOf (long value)))
(defn -main [& arguments]
  (let [wanted (s/argument arguments 27)
        line (StringBuilder. 10)
        output (StringBuilder.)]
    (loop [^BigInteger q BigInteger/ONE ^BigInteger r BigInteger/ZERO ^BigInteger t BigInteger/ONE
           k 1 emitted 0]
      (if (= emitted wanted)
        (do (print (.toString output)) (flush))
        (let [numerator-three (.add (.multiply q three-coefficient) r)
              numerator-four (.add (.multiply q four-coefficient) r)
              ^BigInteger three (.divide numerator-three t)
              ^BigInteger four (.divide numerator-four t)]
          (if (.equals three four)
            (let [number (inc emitted)]
              (.append line (.intValue three))
              (when (or (zero? (mod number 10)) (= number wanted))
                (.append output (String/format java.util.Locale/ROOT "%-10s\t:%d\n" (to-array [(.toString line) number])))
                (.setLength line 0))
              (recur (.multiply q ten) (.multiply (.subtract r (.multiply t three)) ten) t k number))
            (let [factor (integer (inc (* 2 k)))]
              (recur (.multiply q (integer k)) (.multiply (.add r (.multiply q two)) factor)
                     (.multiply t factor) (inc k) emitted))))))))

(ns clbg.spectralnorm.compact (:require [clbg.support :as s]) (:gen-class))
(defn denominator ^long [^long row ^long column]
  (let [sum (+ row column)] (+ (quot (* sum (inc sum)) 2) row 1)))
(defn multiply [^doubles vector transpose]
  (let [n (alength vector) output (double-array n)]
    (dotimes [row n]
      (aset-double output row
        (loop [column 0 sum 0.0]
          (if (= column n) sum
            (recur (inc column)
              (+ sum (/ (aget vector column)
                        (double (if transpose (denominator column row) (denominator row column))))))))))
    output))
(defn ata [vector] (multiply (multiply vector false) true))
(defn result [^doubles u ^doubles v]
  (loop [index 0 uv 0.0 vv 0.0]
    (if (= index (alength u)) (Math/sqrt (/ uv vv))
      (recur (inc index) (+ uv (* (aget u index) (aget v index))) (+ vv (* (aget v index) (aget v index)))))))

  (let [n (int (s/argument arguments 100))]
    (loop [iteration 0 u (double-array n 1.0) v (double-array n)]
      (if (= iteration 10) (s/printf "%.9f\n" (result u v))
        (let [next-v (ata u) next-u (ata next-v)]
          (recur (inc iteration) next-u next-v))))))

      (let [real (+ (- (* zr zr) (* zi zi)) cr)
            imaginary (+ (* 2.0 zr zi) ci)]

(ns clbg.binarytrees.optimized
  (:require [clbg.support :as s])
  (:gen-class))
(defn make-tree [depth]
  (let [node (object-array 2)]
    (when (pos? depth)
      (aset node 0 (make-tree (dec depth)))
      (aset node 1 (make-tree (dec depth))))
    node))
(defn check-tree [^objects node]
  (if (nil? (aget node 0)) 1
    (+ 1 (check-tree (aget node 0)) (check-tree (aget node 1)))))
(defn interval [depth begin end]
  (loop [index begin sum 0]
    (if (= index end) sum
      (recur (inc index) (+ sum (check-tree (make-tree depth)))))))
(defn -main [& arguments]
  (let [maximum (max 6 (s/argument arguments 10))
        stretch (check-tree (make-tree (inc maximum)))
        retained (make-tree maximum)]
    (s/printf "stretch tree of depth %d\t check: %d\n" (inc maximum) stretch)
    (doseq [depth (range 4 (inc maximum) 2)]
      (let [iterations (bit-shift-left 1 (+ maximum 4 (- depth)))
            workers (min 8 iterations)
            totals (s/jobs (mapv (fn [worker]
                                  #(interval depth (quot (* iterations worker) workers)
                                                   (quot (* iterations (inc worker)) workers)))
                                (range workers)))]
        (s/printf "%d\t trees of depth %d\t check: %d\n" iterations depth (reduce + totals))))
    (s/printf "long lived tree of depth %d\t check: %d\n" maximum (check-tree retained))))

(ns clbg.fannkuchredux.compact (:require [clbg.support :as s]) (:gen-class))
(defn rotate-prefix! [^ints permutation last-index]
  (let [first-value (aget permutation 0)]
    (dotimes [index last-index] (aset-int permutation index (aget permutation (inc index))))
    (aset-int permutation last-index first-value)))
(defn flips ^long [^ints permutation]
  (let [work (aclone permutation)]
    (loop [total 0]
      (let [last-index (aget work 0)]
        (if (zero? last-index) total
          (do
            (loop [left 0 right (long last-index)]
              (when (< left right)
                (let [value (aget work left)]
                  (aset-int work left (aget work right)) (aset-int work right value))
                (recur (inc left) (dec right))))
            (recur (inc total))))))))
(defn carry [^ints permutation ^ints counts r n]
  (loop [index r]
    (if (= index n) n
      (do
        (rotate-prefix! permutation index)
        (aset-int counts index (dec (aget counts index)))
        (if (pos? (aget counts index)) index (recur (inc index)))))))
(defn -main [& arguments]
  (let [n (int (s/argument arguments 7)) permutation (int-array (range n)) counts (int-array n)]
    (assert (pos? n))
    (loop [r n rank 0 checksum 0 maximum 0]
      (let [ready (loop [index r]
                    (if (= index 1) 1
                      (do (aset-int counts (dec index) index) (recur (int (dec index))))))
            amount (flips permutation)
            next-checksum (+ checksum (if (even? rank) amount (- amount)))
            next-maximum (max maximum amount)
            next-r (carry permutation counts ready n)]
        (if (= next-r n)
          (s/printf "%d\nPfannkuchen(%d) = %d\n" next-checksum n next-maximum)
          (recur (int next-r) (inc rank) (long next-checksum) (long next-maximum)))))))

(ns clbg.knucleotide.optimized
  (:require [clbg.support :as s] [clojure.string :as string])
  (:import [java.util HashMap Locale])
  (:gen-class))
(def widths [1 2 3 4 6 12 18])
(def queries ["GGT" "GGTA" "GGTATT" "GGTATTTTAATT" "GGTATTTTAATTTATAGT"])
(defn third-record [raw]
  (loop [lines (seq (string/split raw #"\r\n|\r|\n" -1)) selected false output (StringBuilder.)]
    (if-let [^String line (first lines)]
      (cond
        (.startsWith line ";") (recur (next lines) selected output)
        (.startsWith line ">") (if selected (.toUpperCase (.toString output) Locale/ROOT)
                                  (recur (next lines) (or (= line ">THREE")
                                                        (.startsWith line ">THREE ")
                                                        (.startsWith line ">THREE\t")) output))
        selected (do (.append output line) (recur (next lines) true output))
        :else (recur (next lines) false output))
      (.toUpperCase (.toString output) Locale/ROOT))))
(defn code [character]
  (case character \A 0 \C 1 \G 2 \T 3 (throw (IllegalArgumentException. "Invalid nucleotide"))))
(defn histogram [^String sequence width]
  (let [table (HashMap.) mask (dec (bit-shift-left 1 (* 2 width)))]
    (loop [position 0 key 0]
      (when (< position (.length sequence))
        (let [next-key (bit-and mask (bit-or (bit-shift-left key 2) (code (.charAt sequence (int position)))))]
          (when (>= (inc position) width)
            (.put table next-key (inc (long (.getOrDefault table next-key 0)))))
          (recur (inc position) (long next-key)))))
    table))
(defn decode [key width]
  (let [word (char-array width)]
    (loop [index (dec width) remaining key]
      (when (>= index 0)
        (aset-char word index (.charAt "ACGT" (int (bit-and remaining 3))))
        (recur (dec index) (unsigned-bit-shift-right remaining 2))))
    (String. word)))
(defn frequencies [^HashMap table width]
  (let [rows (mapv (fn [entry] [(decode (.getKey entry) width) (.getValue entry)]) (.entrySet table))
        total (reduce + 0 (map second rows))]
    (doseq [[word amount] (sort-by (fn [[word amount]] [(- amount) word]) rows)]
      (s/printf "%s %.3f\n" word (/ (* 100.0 amount) total)))
    (println)))
(defn -main [& arguments]
  (let [sequence (third-record (s/input-text))
        tables (s/jobs (mapv (fn [width] #(histogram sequence width)) widths))]
    (doseq [index (range 2)] (frequencies (nth tables index) (nth widths index)))
    (doseq [[query ^HashMap table] (map vector queries (drop 2 tables))]
      (let [key (reduce (fn [key character] (bit-or (bit-shift-left key 2) (code character))) 0 query)]
        (s/printf "%d\t%s\n" (.getOrDefault table key 0) query)))))

(ns clbg.support
  (:refer-clojure :exclude [printf])
  (:import [java.nio.charset StandardCharsets]
           [java.util Locale]
           [java.util.concurrent Callable Executors TimeUnit]))
(defn argument [arguments default]
  (if (seq arguments) (Long/parseLong (first arguments)) default))
(defn input-text []
  (String. (.readAllBytes System/in) StandardCharsets/ISO_8859_1))
(defn printf [format-string & values]
  (print (String/format Locale/ROOT format-string (to-array values)))
  (flush))
(defn jobs [functions]
  (let [pool (Executors/newFixedThreadPool (min 8 (max 1 (count functions))))]
    (try
      (let [futures (mapv (fn [function]
                            (.submit pool ^Callable (reify Callable (call [_] (function)))))
                          functions)]
        (mapv #(.get %) futures))
      (finally
        (.shutdown pool)
        (when-not (.awaitTermination pool 1 TimeUnit/DAYS)
          (throw (IllegalStateException. "Worker pool did not finish")))))))

(defn rotate-prefix! [^ints permutation last-index]
  (let [first-value (aget permutation 0)]
    (dotimes [index last-index] (aset-int permutation index (aget permutation (inc index))))
    (aset-int permutation last-index first-value)))
(defn flips ^long [^ints permutation]
  (let [work (aclone permutation)]
    (loop [total 0]
      (let [last-index (aget work 0)]
        (if (zero? last-index) total
          (do
            (loop [left 0 right (long last-index)]
              (when (< left right)
                (let [value (aget work left)]
                  (aset-int work left (aget work right)) (aset-int work right value))
                (recur (inc left) (dec right))))
            (recur (inc total))))))))
(defn carry [^ints permutation ^ints counts n]
  (loop [index 1]
    (when (< index n)
      (rotate-prefix! permutation index)
      (aset-int counts index (dec (aget counts index)))
      (when (zero? (aget counts index))
        (aset-int counts index (inc index))
        (recur (inc index))))))

        (let [digit (quot remaining (aget factorial index))]
          (dotimes [_ digit] (rotate-prefix! permutation index))
          (aset-int counts index (- (inc index) digit))
          (recur (dec index) (rem remaining (aget factorial index))))))
    [permutation counts]))
